$description: Parla design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Primitives come from the Parla logo (assets/brand/logo.svg). Semantic tokens per theme reference primitives. Share or fork this file; tokens.css and the built-in theme files follow it (kept by hand; tests compare the themes).

navy.$description: Logo bubble. Primary ink of the light theme.

3xs.$description: Badge counts and rail marks, one step under 2xs.

avatar.$description: Rounded square avatars; circles are reserved for presence.

sm.$description: Icon beside small text and in dense rows.

lg.$description: Icon in a titlebar or panel button.

lock-text.$description: Maximum width of the lock screen's explanation, so it wraps to a short paragraph.

titlebar-search.$description: Maximum width of the titlebar search pill.

titlebar-lights.$description: Left clearance for the macOS traffic lights in the titlebar.

msg-pad-cozy.$description: Vertical padding of a message row at cozy density (compact uses `space.3`).

msg-avatar.$description: Side of the avatar in a message row.

sidebar-header.$description: Height of the sidebar header (workspace name).

sidebar-search.$description: Height of the sidebar's jump-or-search field.

rail-tile.$description: Side of a workspace tile on the rail.

rail-control.$description: Width of the rail's add and profile buttons.

logo-mark.$description: The logo mark on sign-in and About.

logo-about.$description: The logo mark on the About window.

mac-top-inset.$description: Height of the reserved top strip on macOS, aligned with the traffic lights.

menu-row.$description: Height of a row in a popover menu.

avatar-sm.$description: Diameter of a small avatar in the huddle bar.

avatar-xs.$description: Diameter of an avatar in a message preview line (All unreads).

timeline-min.$description: Narrowest the timeline gets for a second right-column pane (search in context).

context-pane-min.$description: Narrowest search in-context pane; below it the pane hides.

avatar-lg.$description: Side of the large avatar on a direct message intro.

avatar-card.$description: Side of the avatar on a People directory card.

people-panel.$description: Width of the People directory beside the conversation (three cards a row).

preset-row.$description: Height of a status preset row in the status dialog.

icon-button-sm.$description: Target of a small icon button inside a chip (shorter than the 26px chip).

indicator-dot.$description: Unread dot on a rail entry (the board's presence dot is also 10px).

workspace-badge.$description: Side of a workspace badge in the rail.

accent-swatch.$description: Diameter of an accent preset swatch on the Appearance page.

sign-in-top.$description: Strip kept above a provider sign-in window for the Cancel button.

dialog-top.$description: Distance from the window top to a top-anchored dialog (quick switcher, command palette, status).

media-width.$description: Default width of an image block.

media-height.$description: Default height of an image block.

clip-volume.$description: Width of the volume bar on a clip card.

command-name.$description: Minimum width of the command name column in the slash menu, so the descriptions align.

field-xs.$description: Narrow inline input, for example the send-later date and time.

field-sm.$description: Short inline input, for example a bookmark title.

field-md.$description: Medium inline input or field column.

input-min.$description: Minimum height of the composer input.

text-area-min.$description: Minimum height of a multi-line text area.

header-info-max.$description: Maximum width of the channel header info block.

tab-height.$description: Height of the tab row under the channel header.

code-head.$description: Height of a code block head (name, language, actions) and of its Expand row.

code-max-w.$description: Maximum width of a code block in the timeline.

code-gutter.$description: Width of the line-number gutter of a code block.

code-fade.$description: Height of the fade above the Expand row of a collapsed code block.

paste-preview-h.$description: Maximum height of the preview in the long-paste snippet offer.

header-total.$description: Channel header strip plus its tab row (header 56px + tab-height 36px); anchors under the header start here.

details-tab-height.$description: Height of the tabs of the channel details panel.

member-row.$description: Height of a person row in the channel details members tab.

setting-row.$description: Height of a settings row in the channel details panel.

popover-sm.$description: Width of a small popover menu.

popover-lg.$description: Width of a large popover list.

toast-width.$description: Width of a toast in the toast stack (board States).

popover-max-height.$description: Maximum height of a scrolling popover list.

dialog-sm.$description: Width of a small dialog (status dialog) and of the About body.

call-card-max.$description: Maximum width of a call card.

dialog-md.$description: Width of a medium dialog or palette.

sign-in-content-max.$description: Maximum width of the workspace picker content.

media-viewer-header.$description: Height of the media viewer header (file name, sender, controls).

media-viewer-footer.$description: Height of the media viewer footer (position and the thumbnail strip).

media-viewer-thumb-width.$description: Width of a thumbnail in the media viewer strip.

media-viewer-thumb-height.$description: Height of a thumbnail in the media viewer strip.

media-viewer-nav.$description: Diameter of the media viewer previous and next buttons.

media-viewer-zoom-label.$description: Width of the zoom percentage between the zoom buttons.

media-viewer-meta.$description: Width of the position label and the key hint at each end of the media viewer footer. Wider than the board's 120px so "3 of 8 in <channel>" fits in English and in 40% longer locales.

media-viewer-card.$description: Width of the file card the media viewer shows for a PDF.

code-viewer-toolbar.$description: Height of the code viewer toolbar (language, Wrap, Line numbers, Copy, Download).

code-viewer-line.$description: Height of one unwrapped line in the code viewer (13px code at 21px leading).

code-viewer-gutter.$description: Width of the code viewer's line-number gutter.

code-viewer-status.$description: Height of the code viewer status bar.

code-viewer-find-input.$description: Width of the code viewer's find field.

code-viewer-find-count.$description: Minimum width of the find match count ("2 of 3"). Wider than the board's 42px so longer locales and "10000+" fit.

window-confirm-min-width.$description: Minimum width of the write confirmation window.

window-confirm-min-height.$description: Minimum height of the write confirmation window.

window-confirm-height.$description: Opening height of the write confirmation window (board McpConfirm): the key-value rows, a short message and the footer without scrolling.

confirm-label.$description: Label column of the write confirmation key-value rows (Client, Tool, Post to, As).

signature-bar.$description: Height of the brand signature bar, the three logo accents in a row along a dialog's top edge.

load-state-height.$description: Height of the loading or error block a side panel shows while its content is missing.

stepper-segment.$description: Width of a done or upcoming segment of the first-run stepper (board Stepper).

stepper-segment-active.$description: Width of the current segment of the first-run stepper.

code-cell-width.$description: Width of one cell of an emailed sign-in code.

code-cell-height.$description: Height of one cell of an emailed sign-in code.

code-dash-width.$description: Width of the dash between groups of sign-in code cells.

code-dash-height.$description: Height of the dash between groups of sign-in code cells.

provider-card.$description: Width of a provider card on the provider picker (board ProviderPicker, three to a row).

first-sync-width.$description: Width of the first-sync progress column (board FirstSync).

sync-step-icon.$description: Diameter of a first-sync step's status circle.

coach-width.$description: Width of a first-run tour coach mark (board FirstRunTour).

coach-height.$description: Height kept free for a tour coach mark when it is placed, so it stays inside the window.

switcher-width.$description: Width of the quick switcher and the command palette.

sheet-width.$description: Width of the keyboard shortcuts sheet.

sheet-search.$description: Width of the keyboard shortcuts sheet's search field.

switcher-top.$description: Distance from the window top to the quick switcher and the command palette.

switcher-input-height.$description: Height of the quick switcher and command palette input row.

popout-header.$description: Height of the thread pop-out window header.

column-wide.$description: Width of a table column that holds a localised status pill.

center-min.$description: Narrowest usable conversation column (header, timeline, composer); with the rail and sidebar it sets the main window minimum width.

window-min-width.$description: Minimum main window width: rail, sidebar and a usable centre column.

window-min-height.$description: Minimum main window height: titlebar, header, a few messages and the composer.

sign-in-min-height.$description: Minimum sign-in window height; the card scrolls below it.

window-settings-min-width.$description: Minimum Settings window width: navigation and a usable page.

window-settings-min-height.$description: Minimum Settings window height; the page scrolls below it.

settings-header.$description: Height of the Settings window header.

settings-nav.$description: Width of the Settings navigation column.

settings-label.$description: Width of the section title column on a Settings page.

settings-content-max.$description: Maximum width of the controls column on a Settings page.

switch-width.$description: Width of a switch track (height is a 20px space, the thumb 16px).

stepper-value.$description: Minimum width of a settings stepper's number and unit, so stacked steppers line up.

day-tile.$description: Side of a weekday tile on the Notifications page (quiet hours days).

status-pill.$description: Height of a settings status pill (a workspace's state, a tool's kind).

theme-card-width.$description: Width of a theme card on the Appearance page.

theme-preview-height.$description: Height of the miniature window on a theme card.

theme-preview-sidebar.$description: Width of the miniature sidebar on a theme card.

density-card-width.$description: Width of a density card on the Appearance page.

time-field-width.$description: Width of an HH:MM field on a Settings page.

light.$description: Parla Light, the default light theme. Navy ink on paper, orange signal.

control.$description: Text field and unticked check box border: 3:1 on app, surface and raised (WCAG 1.4.11).

viewer.$description: Media viewer window: always dark, the same in every theme (MediaViewer board).

danger-text.$description: Text on a danger-coloured count badge.

text.$description: Text on a workspace avatar whose colour is computed from its name.

dark.$description: Parla Dark, the default dark theme. Night ground, navy sidebar, orange accent.

high-contrast-light.$description: Parla High Contrast Light: black on white with a light sidebar and a near-black fill. Every text pair at least 7:1 (WCAG AAA), focus and cursor rings 4.5:1 and every border, badge and indicator 3:1 on every ground, sidebar and rail included. Replaces Parla Light when the OS asks for more contrast and the user has not chosen a theme. Shadows are the Parla Light ones: they are decoration only, borders carry every edge.
